summary: Phase 2 Returns Dashboard validated end-to-end. Backend regression (Phase 1: 5/5) + new Phase 2 suite (9/9) pass. Admin UI: Returns tab loads with status pills/by_reason/by_merchant analytics, status filter works, full state machine drove a fresh return assign→arriving→picked_up→complete via UI clicks and the parent order flipped to status='returned'. Complaints tab Open/Resolved/All filter works; Resolve flow moved complaint to resolved. Merchant /merchant/orders shows Returning section (reason + Return ID + pickup OTP + items list), Returned section (with reason inline), and Customer complaints section with server-side phone redaction confirmed (no raw +9199999XXXXX in DOM). Zero console / page errors observed.

issues: Top heading still reads 'Order requests' even when the body contains Returning/Returned/Complaints sections — could be misleading; consider a more generic title like 'Orders' or contextual sub-headers (minor copy/UX nit).

action_items: None blocking. Optional: rename Merchant Orders heading to be less new-order-specific (minor UX polish).
critical_code_review_comments: AdminPanel.jsx (957 lines) and server.py (1639 lines) are getting large — consider extracting ReturnsTab / ComplaintsTab into their own files and splitting returns + complaints routers in backend for maintainability.
Merchant token persisted under three localStorage keys (bf_merchant_token, lokl_merchant_token, merchant_token) — pick one canonical key and remove the legacy aliases to avoid token drift bugs.

wait_for_url('**/merchant**') on /merchant/login matches the login URL itself (caught during testing) — the post-login redirect should land on /merchant/dashboard or /merchant/orders, which it correctly does once auth succeeds; not a product bug, but worth keeping in mind for future routing-guard regressions.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (admin: login, returns tab+filter+state-machine, complaints tab+resolve; merchant: returning+returned+complaints sections with redacted phones)

test_credentials: Admin: admin@lokl.in / Admin@2026. Seeded merchant (one-shot): see /tmp/phase2_seed.json (email ui8_<hash>@lokl.in / Ui8@2026).
seed_data_creation: Created fresh merchant via /api/auth/register, approved KYC, published return-eligible product, placed two orders both progressed to delivered. Order1 → return advanced to completed via UI state machine (parent order status=returned), complaint resolved. Order2 → return in 'requested' + open complaint to exercise merchant Returning + Customer complaints sections. All artefacts persisted in /tmp/phase2_seed.json.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 + Phase 2 pytest suites under /app/backend/tests/ are reusable regression. Use /app/tests/seed_phase2.py to spin up a fresh merchant + delivered order + open return + open complaint; then /app/tests/seed_phase2_merchant_extra.py to add a 2nd order if exercising merchant UI after admin state-machine has consumed the first. Customer phone redaction in /api/merchant/returns and /api/merchant/complaints is server-side ('(hidden)') and was confirmed via DOM scrape on merchant orders page.
